query_text: Engine overheating rapidly at highway speeds with boiling coolant in reservoir and radiator fan not engaging
brief_rationale: Tests retrieval for cooling system failures, radiator fan relay/circuit faults, and thermostat malfunctions causing severe engine overheating.

query_text: Engine cranks strongly but fails to start with smell of unburnt fuel and no spark on ignition coils
brief_rationale: Addresses primary starting failure where starter motor operates but lack of ignition signal or crankshaft position sensor input prevents combustion.

query_text: Vehicle battery goes completely dead overnight with alternator charging voltage testing normal during idle
brief_rationale: Diagnoses quiescent parasitic battery discharge caused by body control modules, relays, or lighting circuits staying awake when ignition is off.

query_text: Brake pedal sinks slowly to the floorboard at red lights with ABS warning light illuminated on dashboard
brief_rationale: Evaluates critical hydraulic brake failure symptoms including master cylinder internal bypass, ABS modulator valve leakage, and brake fluid pressure drop.

query_text: Automatic transmission delayed engagement into drive and harsh shuddering when shifting between second and third gears
brief_rationale: Investigates transmission hydraulic pressure loss, shift solenoid electrical malfunctions, and torque converter clutch slippage.

query_text: Check engine light flashing with rough idling, severe loss of engine power, and heavy vehicle vibration under load
brief_rationale: Focuses on catastrophic catalyst-damaging misfires caused by bad fuel injectors, worn spark plugs, or ignition coil circuit failures.

query_text: Drastic drop in fuel economy with black smoke from exhaust and rich fuel mixture odor during acceleration
brief_rationale: Retrieves faults related to MAF sensor contamination, leaking fuel pressure regulators, or upstream oxygen sensor bias causing rich fuel trim.

query_text: Instrument cluster displays multiple failure lamps with total loss of CAN communication between engine and transmission control modules
brief_rationale: Investigates vehicle serial data network failures (U0100/U0101 family), bus termination resistor faults, and lost communication between primary powertrain controllers.

query_text: Supplemental restraint system airbag warning light stays on continuously after replacing steering column clock spring
brief_rationale: Tests safety restraint diagnostic retrieval, driver airbag squib deployment circuits, and steering wheel clock spring resistance faults (B0001/B0002).

query_text: Turbocharged vehicle exhibits sluggish acceleration, severe turbo lag, and underboost condition when climbing hills
brief_rationale: Evaluates forced induction troubleshooting including turbocharger wastegate control solenoid faults, charge air boost leaks, and manifold absolute pressure sensor discrepancies.
